video_title: Stephen A. reveals the REAL REASON why the Celtics want Giannis 👀 | First Take

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Boston Celtics are aggressively pursuing a roster change
quotes.excerpt: the Celtics have decided that they're going to make a change
quotes.quote: The important thing that's happened is that the Celtics have decided that they're going to make a change. Jaylen Brown is in this deal on offer, might be a buck within 12 hours or so. The Celtics have reached the conclusion that they are not good enough with where they were. They believe internally they didn't lose in the first round to Philly because Jason Tatum got hurt. They believe they lost because they weren't good enough. And I think they believe that if they had gotten to the next round against the Knicks, they were not good enough to beat the Knicks and would not have been good enough to get out of the East or win the Finals. And so they are aggressively looking to make a change.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown potentially being traded if the Bucks choose Miami
quotes.excerpt: if the Bucks choose the Miami Heat offer, Jaylen Brown will get traded somewhere else
quotes.quote: I believe if the Bucks choose the Miami Heat offer, Jaylen Brown will get traded somewhere else. They are going to move on here. That said, an offer that includes Jaylen Brown and from what I understand, other assets in this deal, potentially including the 27th pick in tomorrow night's draft and potentially other things that the Celtics have either in their draft pick table or on their roster, that's a very compelling offer. And I understand that the initial response is going to be, well, what does Jaylen Brown think about this? From what I understand, Jaylen Brown is accepting this and realizes this is a chance to turn the page in his career and that he may be getting his own team, which is something that he has thought about for some time.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith on Giannis Antetokounmpo joining the Miami Heat
quotes.excerpt: I would love to see him in Miami, but only if he was playing with Bam Adebayo
quotes.quote: I would love to see him in Miami, but only if he was playing with Bam Adebayo and at least and possibly Tyler Herro, which is highly unlikely. Because if you make a deal for Giannis, you're going to have to give up one or if not both of those brothers to get Giannis, and I'm not sure that obviously works. So I get that part, but I would love to see him with Bam Adebayo and Tyler Herro with Eric Spoelstra coaching them, because I think that they would be very formidable because Eric Spoelstra is a Hall of Fame coach.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith on Jaylen Brown's talent and value
quotes.excerpt: from a talent perspective, Jaylen Brown is proven, he's a number one
quotes.quote: When we talk about this deal involving the Boston Celtics, you're talking about Jaylen Brown. We going to peel it off and we going to get right to it. This is what Jaylen Brown wanted, you got it. Jaylen Brown, from a talent perspective, Jaylen Brown is proven, he's a number one. This brother was something special last year. He was an MVP candidate. We ain't taking nothing away from him. This brother was sensational last year when Jason Tatum was out.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics trading Jaylen Brown because he wants to be the number one
quotes.excerpt: they're considering making this move because they know that their number two or 1A wants to be number one
quotes.quote: They're considering making this move because they know that their number two or 1A, as we say, wants to be number one. That's basically what he did. Jaylen Brown doesn't want to fess up to the fact that he told on himself. When you say getting bounced out in the first round of the playoffs and less than 24 hours after your season is over, when the city of Boston, of all places, when they are mourning your team going home in the first round and you haven't even had an opportunity to pass gas and you're saying that was your favorite season, oh, that still sticks at the craw of Boston Celtics fans.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's importance to the Celtics franchise
quotes.excerpt: the Boston Celtics belong to Jason Tatum. It's his team
quotes.quote: Make no mistake, the Boston Celtics belong to Jason Tatum. It's his team. This man is coming off of an Achilles tear and they still ain't thinking about it. We ain't hearing his name in no trade office. We ain't hearing about him. You know why? Because it's not just about his play on the court, it's about how he represents the fabric of the franchise. Jaylen Brown is a good dude. He is not a bad person. He's smart as hell, he's a good dude, high character, the whole bit. But he believes he should be a number one.

quotes.speaker: Jay Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jay Williams on Jaylen Brown's intentional leadership
quotes.excerpt: planting that seed wasn't something that was just done casually. It felt intentional
quotes.quote: We often talk about how smart Jaylen is and you've spoken to him, I've spoken to him before, Wendy, you have as well, like he is brilliant. So it just always makes me think that planting that seed wasn't something that was just done casually. It felt intentional. And maybe Jaylen Brown has everybody exactly where he wants them. Now that's speculation, but you know, I try to find myself as a former player like kind of relate to what he was saying. Like there is something gratifying and rewarding about leading your team in the face of all odds.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith criticizes Jaylen Brown's public comments
quotes.excerpt: you have never been somebody that will sit up there and say what you got to say
quotes.quote: Here's what I want you to stop doing, Jay. You're not somebody, no, I'm going to tell you. You have never been somebody that will sit up there and say what you got to say and then bitch and moan about somebody saying, here's what you said, this is what you meant, this is how it's interpreted. You're going to stand on it. See, you got some of these cats that ain't like that. They'll sit up there and do that and then you want to bitch and moan when somebody says, aha, that's what you, that's what this is about. Nothing wrong with it. Jaylen Brown is worthy of being a number one for more than half the teams in the league.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith praises Jaylen Brown's basketball IQ
quotes.excerpt: nobody gets to question Jaylen Brown's IQ. The brother's off the charts. He's a brilliant brother
quotes.quote: Nobody gets to question Jaylen Brown's IQ. The brother's off the charts. He's a brilliant brother. IQ is another matter. Because you got to remember, you paying attention, it's not just about what you think, how you feel or whatever, it's also how you express yourself when you choose to express it, what form you do it, the timing of it, all of that other stuff. It plays a role. You know this, Jay.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith on Jaylen Brown's reputation and franchise value
quotes.excerpt: it's about him being an NBA veteran, it's about Jason Tatum and Jason Tatum's sterling reputation
quotes.quote: It's not about him being a politician, it's about him being an NBA veteran, it's about Jason Tatum and Jason Tatum's sterling reputation. It's about him and what he's meant to the franchise. It's about all of those things and how you came across when you were talking the way that you were talking, meaning him. I got no problems with Jaylen Brown. Jaylen Brown can ball. He's a league MVP candidate that proved this year. And this is the big thing. You sign for $304 million. You still was number two, and you got an opportunity to be number one. That brother took the bull by the horn and took the hell over and was balling.
